purpose: Inventory every declared export as an explicit semantic unknown, with representative source-observed limitations retained as obligations. Inventory completeness is not semantic review, runtime execution, dynamic-symbol availability or replacement readiness.

semantic_contract_classes.compat_noop: Call is accepted and returns success or no observable action for compatibility, while upstream behavior is not implemented.
semantic_contract_classes.deterministic_fallback: Call returns a deterministic fallback/error/fail-stop result instead of full upstream behavior.
semantic_contract_classes.limited_bootstrap: Implementation supports a useful bootstrap subset, but broader upstream subsystem semantics remain deferred.
semantic_contract_classes.unsupported_platform_contract: Historical, non-Linux, removed, or deliberately unavailable surface returns ENOSYS or an equivalent unavailable status.
semantic_contract_classes.abort_only: Surface intentionally fails closed through abort or process termination instead of performing full upstream behavior.
semantic_contract_classes.proof_gap: Surface is link-compatible and taxonomy-implemented, but a known semantic gap lacks fixture/proof evidence for release-level parity.

entries.current_behavior: RelocationSupport contains Stub and Unsupported variants. Exported-symbol taxonomy, currently including18Stub rows, does not prove per-relocation support.

entries.required_followup: Gate replacement claims on per-relocation class coverage and fixture execution, not only exported-symbol status counts. Keep full semantic status unknown until the named behavior/configuration is actually qualified under bd-reality-202609-lx578q.7.

entries.current_behavior: Registration/cleanup route through the host cancellation chain for host threads or through owned registration and forced unwind for native threads. entries.surface: GNU argp help and reporting helpers
entries.current_behavior: argp_help/state_help use the native tree renderer, filters and caller streams; state_help/usage can exit according to flags. Existing source is broader than the historical literal/no-exit subset; full GNU behavior remains unqualified by this inventory.
entries.user_risk: Command-line programs can still lose option-table help, child-parser/filter behavior, full parser callback diagnostics, and argp-triggered process exits while appearing link-compatible.
entries.required_followup: Add full argp parser/help fixtures for options, child parsers, filters, complete state stream selection, and process-exit behavior before claiming complete GNU argp parity. Keep full semantic status unknown until the named behavior/configuration is actually qualified under bd-reality-202609-lx578q.7.

entries.line_marker: /// GNU asynchronous name/service resolution using the native resolver.
